stage: frozen baseline only; no modified-version comparison yet

environment.topology: One host, four actual original novovm-node processes, four independent AOEM databases; existing WSS/E2E/NovoRUDP configuration.

method.timing: First HTTP submission to all unique four-node finalized receipt observations; signing, startup and cold verification excluded.
method.pooled_tps: total successful transactions / total measured seconds; replicas and authentication counters are not extra transactions.
method.latency: max(four finalized_us observations) - first_submit_us for each transaction; nearest rank ceil(N*p/100)-1 after sorting.
method.merged_latency: All 131072 raw per-transaction latencies from the two complete observations arrays, not an average of percentiles.
method.observations: Complete original observations.json retained as lossless ZIPs; decompressed SHA256 matched originals. No samples, databases or keys copied.
